prerequisites.energy: H4 resting result and combined-TDEE no-go

calibration.target: Prospectively observed expenditure over a declared reference window, not daily scale noise.
calibration.baseline: Frozen uncalibrated Metron estimate and a fixed personal mean trained only in the initial window.
calibration.separation: Fit only on earlier observations; freeze predictions before every evaluation block; report held-out time blocks and entirely held-out participants separately.
calibration.minimumEvidence: Lawful repeated reference expenditure, intake measurement/error information, body-mass time series with fluid/context metadata, device/method identity and missingness.
calibration.confounding: Scale weight alone cannot separate intake bias, fluid/glycogen shifts and expenditure. Do not identify all unknowns from one energy-balance equation.
calibration.intervals: Report sampling, input sensitivity, reference error, model residual and out-of-sample personal coverage separately. No numeric interval ships before coverage evaluation.
calibration.nonImprovement: Retain baseline if improvement/coverage criteria frozen before evaluation are unmet; publish negative and subgroup results.

comprehension.question: Does restricted wording reduce high-consequence interpretation errors and improve scope-aware hypothetical choices compared with selected historical wording?
comprehension.design: Parallel, individually randomized, two-arm moderated pilot; one wording version per participant before all scored responses. Descriptive pilot, not a powered confirmatory trial.
comprehension.changeFromDraft: Replace crossover wording order with parallel allocation to avoid teaching/carryover. The three primary cards isolate wording in matched layouts; two common diagnostics run afterwards. This does not compare complete historical/current apps.

sample.rationale: Feasible bounded pilot of 20 per arm, with explicit precision limits rather than an unsupported power claim. See PROTOCOL.md and the executable planning calculations.
eligibility: Adult aged 18 or above; willing and able to consent
Interested in using an exercise/energy calculator; no wearable required
Can use the frozen English materials with their usual accessibility support
No Metron implementation/review role or prior exposure to these test questions/answers
sample.scope: Purposive English-reading adult sample, not a population survey or accessibility certification. No diagnosis, body measurements, wearable data or personal health histories requested.
sample.stopping: Stop at 40 randomized people, 8 weeks after the run start, or a prespecified interpretation stop. No outcome-dependent replacement or sample-size extension. Report quota and completion shortfalls.

allocation.method: Independently shuffled blocks of four with two H and two R in each quota stratum; coordinator conceals future allocations until consent/eligibility are complete.
allocation.generator: packet.mjs --allocation; generate privately only after run prerequisites are met; never use a published seed or let recruiters choose the next arm.
allocation.blinding: Participants are not told the preferred condition. Two scorers code independently using response text without condition labels; wording may reveal condition, so record suspected unblinding. A third human adjudicates disagreement before the arm key is released.

outcomes.primary: Participant has at least one explicit high-consequence interpretation on T1/T2/T5. Reduction = H proportion minus R proportion.
outcomes.decisionUsefulness: Participant scores 2 on the hypothetical next-action rubric for every primary task, with no critical interpretation. Improvement = R proportion minus H proportion. This is a decision-proxy task, not actual behavior or health benefit.
secondary: Full boundary explanation on each primary task and all three together
T3 uncertainty interpretation and T4 unassisted completion, reported separately
Item-level critical interpretations; missing/assisted responses; completion time
Usefulness rating 1–5 and reasons, reported as perception only
Raw independent-scorer agreement before adjudication; reasons for disagreement
outcomes.denominator: All randomized participants in their assigned arm; withdrawn/unavailable outcomes remain unknown in aggregate accounting, never automatically successful. Complete-case estimates are sensitivity analyses only.

analysis.differenceInterval: Agresti–Caffo adjusted Wald, two-sided; raw point difference and adjusted-centered interval labeled separately
analysis.missingness: Report observed cases, unknown participants, denominator and best/worst bounds. A positive interpretation requires the missingness scenario least favorable to R, not just complete cases.
analysis.smallSample: Intervals quantify sampling variation under the model, not representativeness or physiology. No subgroup benefit claim, p-value fishing, task-level pseudo-replication or optional stopping for success.
analysis.software: analysis.mjs accepts aggregate counts only and never closes H6. Input labels cannot prove that records came from actual people.

decisionRules.kind: Prespecified project judgments, not validated clinical thresholds
decisionRules.promisingSignal: At full planned N with quotas met: H-minus-R critical reduction at least 20 percentage points and its 95% interval lower bound above zero; R-minus-H decision success at least 10 points and its lower bound above zero. Both must survive the least-favorable missingness scenario. R must meet the 80% boundary target on each primary task, unknowns count as not correct, no more than 10% unknown on either endpoint, and no recurring critical interpretation. This is only a pilot signal.
decisionRules.revise: Any explicit critical interpretation is reviewed. Two distinct R participants showing a critical interpretation on the same primary task pause enrollment and block that wording/claim pending repair and a new protocol/material version. Do not weaken an existing restriction because H is worse.
decisionRules.otherResults: Insufficient sample, quotas, completeness or unresolved coding => inconclusive. Adequate completed pilot that misses the margins => improvement not demonstrated. Report negative outcomes; no automatic rollback to historical wording.
decisionRules.gateClosure: Only later criterion-by-criterion human review of actual observations and resulting restrictions can assess H6 criterion 4. Software checks, participant count or a promising label alone cannot close H6.

operations.dataLocation: Private operator-controlled storage outside the repository; aggregate publication only.
operations.consentAndRetention: See PROTOCOL.md; named custodian/contact and retention dates are required before recruitment. No audio/video recording or external transcription in this protocol.

methodSources.scope: Institutional abstract: align sample-size justification with inferential goals; full article not claimed inspected.
methodSources.supports: Explicit resource/precision justification; does not prescribe N=40.

methodSources.scope: Tasks, discussion guides, moderation and assistive-technology sections.
methodSources.supports: Neutral tasks, consistent facilitation and accommodation; hypothetical data limit contextual inference.

methodSources.scope: Participant information, consent evidence, data handling and withdrawal.
methodSources.supports: Participant-process design; not a determination of law or institutional approval for Metron.

methodSources.scope: Wilson score formula and interval interpretation.
Agresti–Caffo formula and worked numerical example.

blockers: Independent human methods/accessibility review and named study operation are not yet recorded.
No real-user comprehension or decision-usefulness observations collected.
No appropriate longitudinal calibration/reference dataset admitted.
